results.title: Malaysia’s E-Invoice Pilot Project and Proposed Rollout Timeline
results.content: Home › Esker Blog › Malaysia’s E-Invoice Pilot Project and Proposed Rollout Timeline. # Malaysia’s E-Invoice Pilot Project and Proposed Rollout Timeline. In early March 2023, the Inland Revenue Board (IRB) of Malaysia unveiled a proposed timetable for the gradual implementation of an electronic invoicing system, known as e-invoicing. The initial group to adopt the new electronic invoicing (e-invoice) system will consist of 4,000 companies with revenue exceeding RM100 million, starting from June 1 next year. The ultimate goal is for all businesses in Malaysia to adopt e-invoicing by January 2027. However, specific details regarding the type of e-invoicing system to be adopted have not yet been publicly released. According to Mohd Nizom, the implementation of the e-invoice system aims to enhance efficiency in the country’s tax management administration, aligning with the objectives outlined in the 12th Malaysia Plan 2021-2025 to strengthen digital infrastructure services. The IRB shared a timeline for the e-invoicing rollout during a recent presentation at the National Taxation Seminar held in early March 2023:. Moreover, starting from January 2024, businesses have the flexibility to voluntarily adopt e-invoicing before the mandatory implementation date that aligns with their sales threshold. The e-invoice system is a crucial part of the government’s plan to digitise tax administration, serving as an initiative to drive the national digitalisation agenda in line with the Digital Malaysia Economic Blueprint (MyDigital). Businesses are advised to stay informed about the forthcoming changes and evaluate how e-invoicing can enhance their operations and compliance. ## **How Esker can help with your e-Invoicing initiative**. Esker’s technology helps companies get the tools they need to deal with the rise in e-Invoicing technology. With decades of experience under Esker’s belt and robust global infrastructure in place, Esker provides your company precisely what’s needed to make your move to e-invoicing a triumphant one. **Esker**è una multinazionale nata nel 1985 e negli anni ha sviluppato una piattaforma cloud globale che aiuta le aziende a gestire i processi business in modalità digitale. **Unica piattaforma cloud** che può gestire sia l’automazione del **ciclo P2P** (supplier management, contract management, procurement, accounts payable, expense management, payment management, sourcing) che **O2C**(order management, invoice delivery, collection&payment management, claims&deductions, cash allocation, credit management e customer management).

results.content: # Project Timeline Calculator. Break down your project into phases and estimate completion dates. ## Project Timeline Calculator. Our free **project timeline calculator** helps you manage complex projects by breaking them into manageable phases. Perfect for **students**, **agencies**, **freelancers**, and **business teams**, this tool allows you to **estimate project duration**, set milestones, visualize your timeline, and accurately forecast completion dates. Plan your project phases effectively, manage expectations, and deliver on time with our intuitive **project management timeline tool**. * While the timeline visualizes project phases, it does not replace comprehensive project management software for detailed task tracking. Whether you're managing a small personal project, coordinating a team effort, or planning a complex business initiative, understanding how to structure and estimate your project timeline can significantly improve your chances of success. A project timeline is a visual representation of a project's phases, tasks, and milestones arranged along a time axis. ### How Project Timelines Are Calculated. Project timeline calculations combine various factors including task durations, dependencies, resource availability, and working schedules to determine start and end dates for each project component. Use progressive elaboration—start with high-level estimates for the full project, then refine upcoming work with more detailed planning as you approach each phase. #### How do I estimate time for each phase of a project? Task or phase duration refers to the amount of time needed to complete a specific component of your project, usually measured in days or weeks of effort. Project length, on the other hand, refers to the total calendar time from start to finish, including all phases, dependencies, overlaps, and non-working periods. Our calculator computes the actual calendar-based project length by accounting for these factors, giving you a realistic completion date rather than just a count of working days. Our calculator precisely computes dates based on the phase durations and dependencies you specify, but the resulting timeline is only as realistic as your estimates. Effective project planning starts with a clear, realistic timeline. Whether you're working on a personal project, managing a team initiative, or planning a complex business program, our Project Timeline Calculator gives you the tools to break down your work into manageable phases, estimate durations accurately, and visualize your complete project lifecycle.
